scope: Independent read-only review of the Village touch, popup-transform, density and open-dialog resize integration. This file documents the completed review; no additional source inspection, runtime test or renderer test was performed when writing it.
review_conclusion: No further concrete integration regression was identified in the exact reviewed source files. This is a source-review conclusion, not runtime or visual acceptance.
confirmed_source_properties: All original probe lines, including its 19 assertions, remain unchanged relative to the committed Village baseline.
The existing world-release function _input() is byte-identical to the baseline.
MOUSE_FILTER_PASS is assigned to children of scrolling toolbars and Village dialogs; ordinary header and next-day buttons retain their existing STOP behavior.
The geometric HUD guard rejects only new press gestures over visible top, bottom and pause controls, preserving release ownership for already-started world gestures.
Injected ScreenTouch and ScreenDrag events pass through Input.parse_input_event and Input.flush_buffered_events; the probe does not invoke toolbar or close handlers to claim touch success.

Target geometry uses the target control own viewport screen transform and its global canvas transform before dividing physical size by the explicit density fixture; it checks minimum 48 dp with the existing numeric tolerance.
The desktop fixture now enables and verifies the existing touchscreen-routing contract and restores the previous touch-emulation setting.
Open-dialog layout lowers min_size before resizing and updates the existing Window before and after popup_centered and during parent layout.
The resize probe preserves the open dialog instance identity, compares its label contents, verifies actual safe-area bounds and performs a subsequent real close touch.
Capture mode rejects a headless display or missing output directory before any success marker; a source-only or headless result cannot claim captured renderer images.

review_findings_resolved_during_root_wor.finding: The first Village probe omitted desktop touchscreen capability, which Godot ScrollContainer requires for its touch-drag path.
review_findings_resolved_during_root_wor.resolution: Root connected the same Input.emulate_touch_from_mouse capability check and restoration already used by BuildDialogDensity.
review_findings_resolved_during_root_wor.evidence_boundary: Early failures without this capability are prototype diagnostics and are not the causal product baseline.

review_findings_resolved_during_root_wor.finding: The published Village buttons block pointer propagation and the published open dialog retains a one-time minimum size after orientation or density change.
review_findings_resolved_during_root_wor.resolution: Root implemented scroll-child PASS plus a HUD press guard and a layout helper that resizes the same open Window.
review_findings_resolved_during_root_wor.evidence_boundary: Runtime red/green evidence was executed by Root and is reported separately below.

engine_source_references.reviewed_contract: _gui_call_input treats ScreenTouch and ScreenDrag as pointer events stopped by MOUSE_FILTER_STOP; force_pass_scroll_events is an exception only for wheel events.
The mouse-emulated touchscreen drag path returns early when DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available is false.
